name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.defines_unique
typeText:
∀ (γ : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance) {A : Type},
  DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.Valid γ →
    ∀
      (I :
        DisequalityDispersion.Interpretation (Fin (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.m γ))
          (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.arity γ) A)
      (a : Fin (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.k γ) → A) (d : A)
      (b : Fin (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.nodes γ)) → A),
      DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.Defines γ I a d b →
        Eq.{1} b (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.extend γ I a d)

source.code:
theorem defines_unique (hv : γ.Valid) (I : Interpretation (Fin γ.m) γ.arity A)
    (a : Fin γ.k → A) (d : A) (b : Fin γ.nodes.length → A) (hb : γ.Defines I a d b) :
    b = γ.extend I a d := by
  have key : ∀ j (hj : j < γ.nodes.length), b ⟨j, hj⟩ = γ.extend I a d ⟨j, hj⟩ := by
    intro j
    induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ j ih =>
        intro hj
        rw [hb ⟨j, hj⟩, γ.extend_defines hv I a d ⟨j, hj⟩]
        apply γ.evalStep_congr hv I a d j hj
        intro i hi
        have hil : i < γ.nodes.length := lt_trans hi hj
        rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simpa using hil),
          List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simpa using hil), List.getElem_ofFn, List.getElem_ofFn]
        exact ih i hi hil
  funext j
  exact key j.1 j.2
